Specification: This module is a very small TLA+ specification used to declare two constants and state a simple assumption about one of them. It assumes that the constant C is the empty set, and it includes a theorem written in ASSUME/PROVE form that proves the boolean constant TRUE under assumption D. The module contains no variables, no actions, no temporal behavior, no fairness constraints, and no algorithmic transition system; it is essentially a minimal logical specification focused on assumptions and a trivial theorem.
